ترتشفوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَشِفُوا (tartašifū) /tar.ta.ʃi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# تُرْتَشَفُوا (turtašafū) /tur.ta.ʃa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
